name: Origin Food Group LLC
old_description: It’s a given that “good food” should taste good. But good food should also be more nutritious.
about:
Origin Food Group LLC is a family-owned food manufacturer headquartered in Statesville, North Carolina. The company traces its roots to South America, where it pioneered functional foods for nearly four decades before expanding its operations to the United States in 2009.

The company develops and produces a range of dairy-based functional foods in-house, including Swiss-style drinkable and spoonable yogurts fortified with vitamins, minerals, and supplements. Its capabilities span contract packing, private label manufacturing, and proprietary product formulation using premium ingredients such as HOWARU® probiotics, TruCal® calcium, Benecol for cholesterol reduction, and iron for anemia prevention.

Origin Food Group serves the food and beverage industry with a focus on dairy, yogurt, and functional food segments. Its customer base includes private label brands and contract packing clients seeking better-for-you products, and it maintains a local supply partnership with Stamey Farms, a multi-generational dairy operation in Iredell County that provides milk for production.

Founded on the belief that nutrition should not be compromised for taste or convenience, the company differentiates itself through a history of category firsts — introducing Swiss-style yogurt to its home market, fortifying every product, and designing each item to deliver measurable wellness benefits such as cholesterol lowering and improved iron status.

name: Original Maine Factory Store
old_description: From lifelong Mainers to those who visit every chance they get, these gifts capture what draws us all here
about:
Original Maine Factory Store operates from Portland, Maine, where it was founded in 2017. The company began as a mission to revive Maine's 1901 state flag, a design featuring a pine tree and North Star that flew from 1901 to 1909. It now operates as part of Maine Flag Company, extending that heritage into a broader collection of locally designed goods.

The brand designs and produces a range of Maine-themed products including hats, apparel, home goods, and flags. Most items are produced in Portland, working with local makers and artisans. The product line spans vintage-style t-shirts, hoodies, beanies, dad hats, trucker hats, and collaborative items such as the Flowfold x Original Maine collection. The company runs a physical factory store in Portland alongside its Shopify-powered e-commerce site.

Original Maine serves retail consumers directly, targeting lifelong Mainers, visitors, and gift buyers seeking authentic Maine-made products. The company does not explicitly describe B2B or wholesale channels in its public materials.

The company states its purpose is to celebrate Maine craftsmanship and design, capturing the independent spirit of the state through thoughtfully designed products that connect people to what Maine represents.

name: Orman's Furniture
old_description: Use our design center to find the right colors for your home. Choose from multiple stain options and wood species.
about:
Orman's Furniture has served Overland Park, Kansas, for over five decades. The retailer operates from a single location on Metcalf Avenue, offering a large open warehouse showroom where customers can browse extensive stock.

The business specializes in solid wood furniture for bedroom, dining room, living room, and office settings. Its inventory emphasizes Amish-crafted collections from makers such as J&R Woodworking and Indian Trail, alongside other American-made lines. Customers can custom-order many pieces, selecting from a range of wood species — including cherry, walnut, hickory, and quarter-sawn white oak — as well as stain colors, genuine and faux leathers, and performance fabrics. An in-store design center allows shoppers to visualize finishes before purchasing.

The company serves residential customers seeking heirloom-quality furnishings, positioning itself as an alternative to national big-box chains. Its showroom operates with immediate availability on many items and offers delivery service.

Orman's frames its value proposition around longevity and personal service, describing itself as "Overland Park's antidote to the out-of-state, big-box stores that promise more than they can deliver." The emphasis on American-made, solid-wood construction and customizable options reflects a focus on durability over disposable trends.

name: Ort Furniture Manufacturing Co
old_description: Experience the Ort difference: handcrafted, American-made furniture built with hardwood frames, Amish craftsmanship, and backed by a lifetime limited warranty for lasting comfort.
about:
Ort Furniture Manufacturing Co has operated from Salem, Ohio since its founding in 1957. The company began as a recliner manufacturer and has expanded to produce a full line of upholstered furniture for residential use.

The company handcrafts furniture using solid hardwood frames built by Amish craftsmen, paired with sustainably sourced wood and strengthened steel hardware. Its product range includes more than 70 recliner styles—electric power, oversized, mission, wall-hugger, swivel rocker—as well as sofas, love seats, chairs, modular seating, and occasional pieces. Customers can choose from over 360 premium fabric and leather options for customization.

Ort Furniture sells primarily through retail furniture stores across the Midwest, supplying independent dealers with its American-made upholstered lines. The company also operates a direct-to-consumer showroom and e-commerce channel, offering free shipping on all orders with no minimum purchase.

The business emphasizes durability and comfort, backing every piece with a lifetime limited warranty. Its differentiation rests on Amish construction techniques, domestic manufacturing, and a broad customization program that allows retailers to tailor pieces to regional tastes.

name: Otco Inc
old_description: Built to Protect Your Facility, Improve Energy, & Keep Every Load Secure
about:
OTCO, Inc. was founded in 1988 in Fond du Lac, Wisconsin, as a fourth-generation family-owned industrial contract sewing manufacturer. The company began with a focus on custom sewn products for demanding industrial applications and has operated continuously from its Wisconsin facility for over three decades.

The company specializes in heavy-duty industrial sewing and custom textile fabrication, producing items such as loading dock seals and shelters, lift table guards, bellow guards, and a wide range of custom bags including locking bank bags and HIPAA-compliant medical bags. All products are manufactured in their Wisconsin facility, where an experienced team handles everything from prototypes to production runs, offering branding options like sewn-in tags, silk-screen printing, and embroidery.

OTCO serves customers across manufacturing and industrial, warehousing and logistics, medical and healthcare, government and municipal, banking and financial services, education and institutions, and retail and commercial sectors. Their solutions address machinery protection, material handling, facility energy efficiency, secure document and cash transport, and institutional safety and organization.

The company emphasizes a hands-on, consultative approach—starting each project by listening to the customer’s application, environment, and priorities—to deliver custom-built, American-made solutions without pre-made shortcuts. They highlight decades of practical experience, consistent inspection at every production stage, and a commitment to on-time fulfillment as key differentiators.

name: Otter Tail Power Company
old_description: Keeping power reliable and costs predictable for the communities we serve
about:
Otter Tail Power Company is an electric utility headquartered in Devils Lake, North Dakota. The company has provided electricity to communities across the region for more than a century, though a specific founding year is not publicly stated. It operates as a regulated utility serving customers in North Dakota, Minnesota, and South Dakota.

The company generates, transmits, and distributes electric power to residential, commercial, and industrial customers. It also administers energy efficiency programs, including rebates for heat pumps and air conditioners, and offers customer self-service options for billing, service requests, and outage reporting. Operational scale details such as facility size, employee count, or generation capacity are not disclosed in the available sources.

Otter Tail Power serves a mixed customer base across its three-state service territory. Residential customers use the utility for home heating, cooling, and general power needs. Commercial and industrial customers rely on the company for consistent, low-cost electricity to support operations. The utility also provides energy assistance information for customers facing financial hardship.

The company states its purpose is to keep power reliable and costs predictable for the communities it serves. It emphasizes safe and efficient operations carried out by a dedicated workforce, though specific differentiators such as unique generation assets or grid technology are not detailed in the source material.

name: Our World Energy, LLC
old_description: Get your customized solar plan and quote by filling out this form.
about:
Our World Energy, LLC is headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, and was founded in 2016 by Caleb Antonucci. The company began as a bridge connecting solar professionals with homeowners seeking affordable energy independence, later evolving into a direct installer of residential solar systems.

The firm designs and installs photovoltaic systems for single-family homes, using what it describes as locally manufactured solar panel technologies. Its certified solar specialists are cross-trained as roofing experts, allowing the company to handle both the structural and electrical aspects of each installation. Operations span 16 states and territories, including Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Mexico, Puerto Rico, Rhode Island, Texas, Vermont, and Virginia.

The primary customer base is residential homeowners looking to reduce monthly electricity costs and gain energy independence. The company markets its solutions directly to consumers in the listed service areas, emphasizing a transparent, partnership-based sales process.

Our World Energy differentiates itself with a 25-year, no-strings-attached warranty on its installations, a people-first approach that walks customers through every step, and the integration of roofing expertise to ensure precise, tailored system mounting.

about:
Outcast AutoWorks LLC operates from Sarasota, Florida, where it designs and fabricates custom truck and automotive parts for the aftermarket. The company's founding year and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed.

Its capabilities include design, welding, and machining of thick-gauge steel ball-joint plates, with bolt-in removable ball joints that simplify replacement and finishing. All control-arm kits ship with hardware, bushings, and alignment shim packs.

Outcast AutoWorks serves the automotive aftermarket, targeting Crown Victoria enthusiasts, fleet maintainers, and custom-truck builders who need direct-replacement or upgraded suspension parts. The company sells directly to consumers through its online store and also offers branded apparel and decals.

The brand positions its parts as a path "from clunker to commuter," emphasizing bolt-on installation, durable materials, and complete kits that reduce the need for additional sourcing. The removable ball-joint design also allows for easy powder-coating or painting to match a build's aesthetic.

name: Outdoor Interiors
old_description: Explore fresh horizons with us as we introduce you to some groundbreaking innovations. Your journey to a more stylish and comfortable year begins here!
about:
Outdoor Interiors was founded in 2006 by Tim Cimaglio in Lake Barrington, Illinois. The company began with the goal of creating a distinctive product line in the outdoor living space, targeting an underserved niche with quality furniture at mid-tier price points.

The company designs and manufactures outdoor furniture using a blend of materials including FSC-certified teak, plantation-grown eucalyptus, powder-coated aluminum, HDPE all-weather wicker, nautical rope, sling fabrics, concrete composite, and natural stone. Operations span over 70,000 square feet of warehouse space and a 5,000-square-foot showroom at Atlanta's AmericasMart, with an additional showroom in Lake Barrington available by appointment. The product range covers folding loungers, stacking chairs, table sets, daybeds, and throw pillows across collections such as Bronson, Magnolia, Kimberly Ann Designs, and Antique Wash Eucalyptus.

Outdoor Interiors sells through a network of more than 150 dealers across North America and key retail groups. The dealer-focused model serves residential customers seeking patio and garden furnishings, while the showrooms support both dealer and designer specification.

The brand differentiates itself through sustainable sourcing of plantation-grown hardwoods, integrated storage solutions in fully assembled pieces, and a mixed-material aesthetic that combines wood, metal, wicker, rope, concrete, and stone at accessible price points.
